description: Geodata_stadantwerpen is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Stad Antwerpen. This site is the portal of GIS-departement of the city of Antwerpen. You find all their geodatasets en corresponding services here. The city of Antwerp has a wealth of geographical data about the city. Through this portal you are offered the opportunity to explore, visualize and download this geographical data. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in JSON. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2026-05-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
